title: Renewal Remittance by the Insured Before the Term End — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Renewal remittances on NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

A renewal remittance is the amount the insured remits, before the term end, for the coming term of an NFIP Dwelling Form policy — the term that starts on the current term's expiration date. The terms below apply on tiers that carry no ICC coverage.

A remittance on a tier that carries ICC coverage is not settled under this schedule: it is referred to the underwriting desk and nothing is computed under this schedule.

**When the remittance is fixed.** The renewal remittance is fixed only after the premium account for the expiring term carries the charge for every coverage change recorded during that term.

**What the payment does.** One payment of the stated amount is received and applied to the policy for the term that starts on the current term's expiration date, and it lowers the amount owed on the policy. When a residence credit is stated, it is booked first as a re-rate credit on the HFIAA surcharge line of the current term, also lowering the amount owed. A payment reference is issued for the payment item.

### Handing over `pay_renewal_premium_abaf74a5`

`pay_renewal_premium_abaf74a5` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to make the payment. It records the payment exactly as stated and computes nothing.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | The reference number of the NFIP Dwelling Form policy being renewed, as given to the insured by the representative from the policy lookup |
| `payment_method` | How the insured pays — one of `CHECK` (a check drawn on the insured's bank account), `ACH` (a one-time debit authorized by routing and account number), `CREDIT_CARD` (a credit or debit card), `ESCROW_DISBURSEMENT` (only when the payment is a disbursement from the lender's escrow account rather than the insured's own funds), `NONE` (only when no payment item exists, which never applies to a payment the insured makes) |
| `amount` | The amount paid, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places |
| `residence_credit` | The credit on the current term's HFIAA surcharge line booked with the payment, in US dollars as a non-negative number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half-up to the cent; zero when no such credit is due |

**Receipt.** "Payment <payment reference> of <amount> by <method> received for policy <policy reference>, term starting <YYYY-MM-DD>; residence credit <amount>; balance now <amount>." Amounts are US dollars with 2 decimals; the payment reference identifies the payment item and the balance is the amount owed on the policy afterwards.
